notes.title: Update v1.3.0 (03/06/2023)
notes.content:
Hello friends! A small but very important update has been released for the game!
Added offline mode.
After downloading the update, check the integrity of the game files.
To start the game in offline mode, click the 'Offline Mode' button on the region selection screen.

The online mode is not yet available, in the near future we will try to set everything up and start the server. Unfortunately the move took longer than expected.

[b]List of changes: [/b]
1) Added offline mode. Now the game can be launched even without the Internet, but a separate profile will be used in offline mode
2) Fixed a bug where the game world could start loading twice in a row after creating a room, this led to sector loading errors and could break the game
3) Fixed some errors in the text
4) Added a limit of 60 frames
5) Increased damage for fisticuffs 5->20
6) Increased damage for self-propelled gun 35 -> 45
7) Increased stamina recovery time by 50%

15) Fixed a bug when the sound of a shot at the NPC could be played twice.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1 [04/05/2018]
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/6Esg11dn3eE

Hi everyone! The next update is uploaded to the servers, It's brought plenty of new things into the game and also fixes! We suggest you to watch a trailer released specially for this event.
Several previous updates were not that successful and some players had lost their interest in the game, we really apologize for this. We completely revised the development plan and focused on developing the main game mode, in the near future we will release another update with a lot of new content!
Unfortunately, we did not manage to finish the work on the quests for the location of "Dead swamp" and not to delay the release of the whole update decided to transfer this task to the next update.

Friends! After the previous update, many players reacted very negatively to the new "Last Survivor" mode, which is only a small addition to the main mode, writing a lot of negative reviews about the game.
If you like the game, please write a review about it in the Steam store. This is very important for us and will greatly help us in the promotion and further development. Thank you for being with us!

[b]UPDATE [04/05/2018][/b]
[b][Innovations][/b]
1) Added a new location "Dead swamp".
2) Added a new mini-location "Catacombs".
3) Added safes with various valuable items. To open them you will need special keys that can be found in the game world or bought from the merchants.
4) Added some new items:
   Clothing:
   1. Armor helmet 'Altyn' in two colors (black and green) with visor and without.
   2. Helmet "Peacemaker".
   3. Uniform of a soldier (camouflage and digital flora).
   4. Militia shirt with a bulletproof vest.
   5. Tactical pants (narrow and wide).
   6. Suit UKB-1 (Reinforced armor-1). Powerful equipment consists of the following elements: Helmet, jacket, pants, gloves, exoskeleton.
To wear this uniform, you need to collect all the elements and alternately put on the character, the last thing you put on is an exoskeleton.
To operate the costume, a reactor battery is required, which is installed in an exoskeleton.
In working order (when all parts of the suit are worn and the battery charge is not less than 5%), the suit provides a lot of advantages: increased damage in close combat, increased protection from external damage, light aiming and so on.
With a discharged battery, the character management becomes less convenient. You can not run, turns become slow and awkward. Note that in addition to the charge indicator there is an overheating indicator, which depends on the external damage received, after overheating, emergency cooling will work, as a result of which you lose part of the charge and the suit becomes inactive for a while.
A suit without an exoskeleton equipped has some protective characteristics, but half that of an exoskeleton.
In the store, this costume cannot be bought, only to be found in parts in the game world.
   Weapon:
   1. Toxic Kalashnikov.
   2. Gauss Gun. The version of the sniper rifle.
   
   Backpacks:
   1. Hiking Backpack.
   2. Sports backpack (blue and green).
   
5) Added a new recipe for crafting: Makeshift Bandage.
6) Added spawn of bee hive and the ability to get honeycombs.
7) Added three variants of new goals for the character.
8) Added two options for new legs for the character.
9) Added new animal bosses: SABER-TOOTHED RAT, CRESTBACK BEAVER, BEAR MANEATER.
10) Added new animals: beavers, rats, elk, deer, wild boar, fox.
11) Added a new type of NPC - Bosses. Powerful NPCs, dressed in the suit UKB-1 (reinforced armor kit).
12) Added and revised many background sound effects.
13) Added blood sprays in new variations when hitting a firearm.

[b][Changes][/b]
1) The controller of the camera is improved, bugs are fixed, under which the camera constantly got into walls, roofs and other colliders.
1) Now for the automatic start of the match in the "Last Survivor" mode, 4 players are required, the match start timer is increased to 5 minutes and is not updated when new players are connected. This means that as soon as 4 players are typed, in 5 minutes the match will begin.
2) Now when the inventory is closed, it disappears less smoothly, thereby correcting some problems and artifacts upon reopening.
3) Improved display of pop-up messages, increased speed of appearance and reduced speed of disappearance.
4) The shooting system of the conventional gauss gun is redesigned: the effects of the shots are updated, the speed of shooting is increased, the ammunition is increased to 30.
5) Now cough with toxicity appears, if the criticality of poisoning is 25% or higher.
6) Improved system of rocking weapons when aiming, reduced speed and radius of movement.
7) The scatter in the RPD is reduced.
8) Now you can buy only one sniper rifle - SVD, all the others are removed from the store.
9) Some pistols are removed from the store.

[b][AI NPC][/b]
1) Now NPCs do less damage when hit in the head.
2) Balance is made in NPC settlements, accuracy of shooting is reduced, NPS with low level of complexity are added.
3) Increased the damage of cold weapons by NPS by 2 times.
4) Fixed a bug where NPCs rebounded very quickly.
5) Fixed a tank that did not show objects in the inventory of the killed NPC.
6) Added a possibility to hit with a rifle.
 7) The system of spawning settlements has been improved. Fixed errors of incorrect initialization of settlements, as a result of which there could have appeared not clad NPCs or NPS in T-poses.
8) The sounds of NPC steps are added.

[b][Corrections][/b]
1) Fixed the main situations that caused the error "Memory cannot be read".
2) Fixed a bug where the animation of opening the door in the reclining position was played.
3) Fixed bugs, where you could climb into the fireplace, on the railing and the window (a house with a merchant in Dyatlovo).
4) Fixed a bug where it was impossible to sell weapons added in the last update.
5) Fixed a bug where crash occurred if you quit the game immediately from the game world.
6) Fixed a bug where the blood particles were not correctly displayed during bleeding.
7) Fixed a bug where particles of blood when hit by enemies ceased to be displayed.
8) Fixed a bug where you could get out of the half-squat in low places.
9) Fixed a bug where the backpack was missing if it was worn immediately after removing the backpack.
10) Fixed a bug where the corpses of characters fell through after the unloading of the location sectors.
11) Fixed a bug in the "Last survivor" mode, in which a parachute flight broke, if the character was sitting in front of him.
12) Fixed a bug where the battery interface of the flashlight battery did not disappear after the death of the character.
13) Fixed a duff of objects when dropping a backpack.
14) Fixed a bug where objects in containers did not spawn.
15) Fixed a bug where animals did not react to the player next to the bushes.
16) Fixed a bug where you could shoot during crawling.
17) Fixed a bug where animals could not move and lost the animation of receiving damage, if they are attacked from several sides.
18) Fixed a bug where players could shoot through some of the colliders.

To operate the costume, a reactor battery is required, which is installed in an exoskeleton.
In working order (when all parts of the suit are worn and the battery charge is not less than 5%), the suit provides a lot of advantages: increased damage in close combat, increased protection from external damage, light aiming and so on.

Note that in addition to the charge indicator there is an overheating indicator, which depends on the external damage received, after overheating, emergency cooling will work, as a result of which you lose part of the charge and the suit becomes inactive for a while.
A suit without an exoskeleton equipped has some protective characteristics, but half that of an exoskeleton.
In the store, this costume cannot be bought, only to be found in parts in the game world.

notes.title: Release delay and next update
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

First of all I would like to inform you that the game will remain in the Early Access for a while.

As you may know, yesterday we released an update that many of you did not like. We understand that this new game mode does not completely convey the point of our game and you were waiting for the evolution of the main mode. Do not be upset, for fans of the main mode we are preparing next update and want to tell you more about it.

At the moment we are polishing new location named Dead Marshes. Take a look on screenshots below. The size of new location is similar to Primorye map. We are preparing about 20 unique quests which tells a story of group of scientists who have been investigating the reason of catastrophe and where toxic fog comes from.

In the factions settlements you will meet fighters in new reinforced armor sets and a chance to loot a part of that armor (if you find out how to kill one of them) as well as the key to the iron safe that will appear somewhere in these settlements.

We are also changing balance of the game items. Some good weapons will be removed from the game store but the ammunition will remain.

Most recently, we have prepared several new animal models that will be added soon.

notes.title: UPDATE [20/02/2018]
notes.content:
Hello! We are glad to announce that today we have released pretty big update that is scheduled to the upcoming release of the game from early access. 

This update is not as big as we planned, some things had to be postponed. However we managed to finish the main update- the new mode "Last Survivor". 

A few words about the new mode: the main thing is to remain the last survivor in the zone, which gradually fills with a toxic fog. During the match you can earn experience, thanks to which the level of your character gradually increases. Players who take 5-1 places receive a reward, game items that can be used in the next matches. The player who took the first place can pick up any five items that he managed to collect in the current match.

As we’re moving on to the release version, we had to zero out some data on all accounts: storages and money. This is due to the large number of vulnerabilities found (dupes and others during the early access). Earlier we warned about this. Thank you for understanding.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26828509/d3aae1d384743a2f5f863dbc5ef1bc2d89945d50.jpg[/img]

https://youtu.be/4Xl91EiIkoM

[Fixes]
1) Fixed a bug when the character was dealt damage after exiting the swimming stater, if he fell into water before that.
2) Fixed a bug when the grenades did not sink and stayed on top of the water.
3) Fixed a bug when the bolt of the weapon was displayed incorrectly when firing.
4) Fixed a bug when the sound looped after the death of the character.
5) Fixed a bug when some game objects could hang in the air before the physical interaction was activated.
6) Fixed a bug when the NPC played an invisible guitar.
7) Fixed a bug when some NPCs did not join the battle and ignored the players after the respawn.
8) Fixed collision in sedentary NPCs.
9) Fixed a bug when NPCs fired at walls and other obstacles.
10) Fixed a bug when NPCs pushed players that were sitting by the fire.
11) Fixed a bug when NPCs did not spawn in big settlements. 
12) Fixed collision in the military boxes with tents, in which objects could fall through the tent.
13) Fixed bugs with quest NPCs in the tasks "Old Church", "Saboteurs", which did not appear or after the murder, which progress did not move on. Dupe on them is also crocked.
14) Fixed a bug in the quest "Lighthouse Repair", when the marker was present, but the action was unavailable.

[New]
1) Added a new mode of the game "The Last Survivor", only one location "Primorye" is available at the moment.
2) Added leader lists in the form of large billboards that are located in the game world.
3) Added a new level loading system, now the game world is loaded by small chunks, due to this the amount of used memory is reduced, the world loading and the transition between the locations became several times faster.
4) Added new weapons: HK G36, HK G36 Camouflage, USAS-12, Galil, RPD.
5) Added UI list of recipes for crafting. (A button with a "?" in the crafting window).
6) Notes are now automatically opened for reading if they are selected for the first time.
7) Added a new sound solution  for the quests (beginning / end of the quest).

[Changes]
1) Changed the weight of the box with bullets for PM. Now the box weighs 0.4 Kg.
2) The model and animations of the animal "Hare” are updated.
3) Now the grenades deal damage to passengers in vehicles.
4) The spawn loot system in killed NPCs has been updated. The number of items is cut. Dropouts are determined randomly.
5) Changed the time of respawning of the broken vehicles to 40 min. Drowned vehicles respawn in 20 minutes.
6) Improved target detection system for NPC.
7) Removed all messages related to early access.
8) Now if the player came to a quest settlement already cleared by someone, the message "Settlement has been stripped before you" will be displayed.
9) Updated the title art when starting the game.

notes.title: UPDATE [13/12/2017]
notes.content:
[Corrections]
1) Fixed the bug when the collision between players and animals didn't work.
2) Fixed the bug when the process of skills learning wasn't updated after the character’s respawn.
3) Fixed the bug when weapon skills could be upgraded using traders of the opposite faction.
4) Fixed the bug when the faction was reset when one restarted the game after completing the quests line "Redemption".
5) Fixed the bug when small cars could enter through the net (pass the guard?) at the "Berezki" location.
6) Fixed the bug when some objects could be seen through the grass.
7) Fixed the bug when there were no shadows on the roads.

8) Fixed the bug when the quest "Swamp raid" restarted automatically when the game was relaunched.

9) Fixed the bug when one could push NPC (Storekeeper) out from the storage.

10) Fixed the bug when the control couldn't be switched on after changing the location in the car. 

11) Fixed the bug when live animation could be played on a dead animal and it could not be killed.
12) Fixed the bug when invisible animals could attack the player.
13) Fixed the bug when NPCs didn’t attack passengers in the car. Now, if the player in the car hits the NPC, the passengers get into the list of enemies as well.
14) Fixed the bug when players could kill passengers of an APC.
15) Fixed the bug when you could push NPC into buildings or underground.
16) Fixed the bug when it was impossible to get the "Mad Driver" achievement.

[Innovations \ Changes]
1) Added 16 new quests of the "Military" faction on the Primorye location.
2) The Ragdoll system has been removed due to unpredictable behavior and a performance drop.
3) Increased the distance of displaying information about the player up to 150 meters.
4) Added game penalty for brazen bug usage from the trader in "Dyatlovo".
5) Optimized the system of putting on hats, fixed the bug with double prefab load.
6) Optimized spawn loot system in containers, fixed the bug with automatic loading of information about objects.
7) The system of creating additional weapons items (shot effects, etc.) is optimized.
8) The rendering of game objects is optimized, GPU Instancing is enabled.
9) Car physics is optimized; synchronization errors are corrected.
10) The system of synchronization of NPC settlements’ been optimized, synchronization errors have been corrected.
11) Added new achievements:
1. "Sniper",
2. "Modern technologies",
3. "Heavy artillery",
4. "Collector",
5. "Wheeling and Dealing",
6. "Spiderman".
12) Added a new mechanics for interacting with objects in inventory:
1. Now you can change the items dressed on your character without having to remove the ones already dressed, just transfer the desired item to the area of ​​the equipment slots and the item that is already dressed will be placed in the backpack if there is space or it will be laid out next to the character.
2. Added the ability to put weapons in the desired slot and replace the already equipped ones.
3. Added the ability to replace backpacks without having to move items to the hand, if you replace the backpack with many slots on a backpack with a smaller amount, then items that do not fit will be laid out next to the character.
These mechanics work for backpacks, containers and storage.
13) Updated sounds while crawling.
14) The algorithm of "Salvation" of cars has been improved, the possibility of getting the car inside buildings is excluded.

notes.content:

Today we have uploaded one more big update that contains a lot of new mechanics and content.
If you have found a bug,or an error, please report it to us and be patient.

If you like our game please rate it and leave a review on Steam, it will help in game promotion, as we are working hard for you.

Thank you, see you in the game!

3. Fixed a bug when the selected item in the market did not stand out when selected.

11. Another dupe of items has been fixed.
12.Fixed synchronization errors in NPC settlements.
13. Fixed cars, improved braking and acceleration.
14. Fixed a bug when it was possible to kill the passengers of an APC.
15. Fixed a bug when sound and walking animation were out of sync.

[b][Updates][/b]
1. Updated the Steamworks libraries.
2. Updated anti-cheat system.
3. Updated version of the game engine.

2. Added NPCs for the transition between the locations "Primorye" and "Berezki".
3. Single player mode is now separated in the mode menu, the description of the mode is added.
4. Added the ability to create private game servers with a password: if you enter a password in the mode selection window, the game will create a private server for you, if the field is left blank, the game will find  the already created server with all the parameters set (e.g. location, number of players).
5. Added arts for each of the game modes.
6. The "Exit" button is added to the region selection menu

10. Increased the damage from melee weapons and gun stock blows by 50%.
11. Increased the damage from fisticuffs by 2 times.
12. improved the controller for detecting camera and object collisions, fixed some bugs with camera jamming in objects.
13. The "Antitoxin" skill has been fixed, now only 22 antitoxins are required to learn all skill levels.

14. New skills are added:
1. Enhanced Regeneration;
2. Melee Combat Master;
3. Berserker;
4. Cowboy;
5. Hunter;
6. Storm trooper;
7. Demolitionist;
8. The path to freedom.

15. Added a system of character levels: the main level of the character consists of the number of learned skill levels of your character.

16. Added new achievements:
1. Self-defense;
2. The Insane Driver;
3. The Gladiator

17. Added the ability to close the doors in the car. Press Q while in the car.
18. The map shows only permanent survivor settlements; Now the color of the settlement border depends on your faction: red for enemies, green for allies, and white for neutrals.
19. Now you can talk to NPC when he is injured or when other players talk to him.
20. Added a line of quests "Redemption" to reset reputation and faction to neutral.

notes.title: More information on the next update!
notes.content:
Hello! Currently, our team is working on the upcoming update that is scheduled for mid-September, this update will be the largest ever. 

[b] List of main innovations: [/b]

5) Improved melee system, now there's no need to aim accurately at the scope.
6) Possibility to choose a settlement for respawn after the death of the character. 

This list is not complete, some more important mechanics and a lot of small fixes are in development, we'll tell about them later.
